name: Restart Button
description: A Restart card in DeepSeek Harness Settings: replaces the dsh web process serving the page and reconnects the page by itself, so host-half plugin changes or config edits take effect without touching a terminal.
descriptionZh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 设置页加一个「重启」卡片：一键替换正在服务当前页面的 dsh web 进程，页面自动重连。改完插件宿主半或配置后，不必再回终端操作。
